g.text: Method 4 (mAP Sel): Global Event Query fine-tuned with model selection on highest Val Localization mAP.

g.text: Method 5 (SI-Bind): Inter-layer Residual Binding with Dominance-Aware Slot Refresh and Slot-Private Innovation (Ours).

g.text: Orc-Gap (%): Area between Oracle envelope and G-mIoU@1 threshold curve across tau in [0, 1] (Integral of Oracle_G1 minus G1-AUC).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Note: Lower Orc-Gap is better (bold marks lowest gap per backbone), directly quantifying G-mIoU loss caused by imperfect query existence gating.
